345 anakeimai {an-ak-i'-mahee}

源自 303　與 2749; TDNT - 3:654,425; 動詞

欽定本 - sit at meat 5, guests 2, sit 2, sit down 1, be set down 1,
     lie 1, lean 1, at the table 1; 14

1) 躺下, 斜靠  (#可5:40|)
2) (斜靠在桌上) 用餐
